heartbeat_reference_solution.rule: HeartBeat references are daemon-free protocol derivations from the HB32 100 Hz oscillator anchor; process absence cannot be treated as heartbeat absence or progression failure.

worker_presence_solution.rule: When a canonical carrier is live and WorkerCoordinator is absent, the existing carrier-owned supervision visit restores the existing WorkerCoordinator, requires a fresh task-capable tick, persists runtime-presence evidence, and lets WorkerCoordinator drain resident requests under its own authority.

stale_runtime_source_solution.rule: The existing native WorkerCoordinator refreshes already-local canonical source before the resident request sweep; refresh includes the self-heal module and preserves mutable runtime state.

incomplete_resident_stack_solution.rule: If local runtime/source materialization is incomplete, reuse the existing one-shot resident stack activation path to package the sovereign control bundle, run local StegDeploy, bootstrap the resident stack, and return to existing WorkerCoordinator dispatch.

selection_order: derive current HeartBeat reference from the existing oscillator protocol anchor without waiting for a heartbeat process
reuse existing carrier WorkerCoordinator self-heal when carrier presence exists and worker presence is missing
reuse existing local-only source refresh so the resident runtime carries the current repair/consumer code
reuse existing one-shot resident stack activation when resident materialization/source roots are incomplete
on CURRENT_USER_IPHONE consume the released StegOS Ecosystem Chat interface and let the canonical portable WorkerCoordinator acquire a fresh parent fence >24 (G25 or greater)
continue through the existing local service-worker inference surface, exact TVC route, exact LLM-adapter measured execution, and existing Master Records same-execution reconstruction
forbidden_reactions: create a duplicate Ecosystem Chat resident request
mint a manual parent claim or fence
reuse G23 or G24 for a fresh/reset portable Ecosystem Chat parent checkout
treat GitHub or hosted validation as runtime repair authority
wait passively on an unchanged resident-process absence without selecting the existing remediation chain
